name: head_turn_wan
default_prompt: the cat turns its head smoothly, body still

3-2.prompt: the cat turns its head a little to its right, eyes following, eyes stay wide open with no blinking, body still

2-1.prompt: the cat turns its head further to its right and looks off to the side, body still

3-4.prompt: the cat turns its head a little to its left, eyes following, body still

4-5.prompt: the cat turns its head further to its left and looks off to the side, body still
